<reason>Side A won by answering B's central definitional trap and keeping live routes B never neutralized. A's target-and-context rule - ban hunting people, permit intercepting objects - resolved the Aegis dilemma, exposed B's ban-equals-regulation claim as wordplay over normal ban scope, and left moral accountability, correlated automated error, flash-war escalation, and stigma/supply effects standing.
